sources.snippet: Bemba ↔ English Translation Models Model Summary Bidirectional neural machine translation models for Bemba (ChiBemba), a major Zambian Bantu language spoken by ~4 million people, and English. These models enable high-quality translation between Bemba and English in both directions, supporting language preservation and digital inclusion efforts in Zambia. sources.title: ModelFront for Bemba
sources.snippet: ModelFront provides AI to check and fix AI translations between hundreds of languages, including Bemba. ModelFront's private custom LLMs for quality prediction and automatic post-editing were fundamentally built to support more than 100 languages from day one. Bemba (Ichibemba) is a Niger-Congo language spoken by millions of people in Zambia.
